title: Pigeons: The Ultimate City Survivors
tags: pigeon facts you need to know
why are there so many pigeons in cities
why are there so many pigeons
description:
Visit any city in the world and you’ll notice pigeons are everywhere — on rooftops, AC units, statues, and town squares. Loved by some and despised by others, these “rats with wings” have become one of the most visible birds in urban landscapes. But why do pigeons dominate our cities more than any other bird?

In this episode of Pale Blue Thoughts, we explore the fascinating history of pigeons, from their domestication by Sumerians in 3000 BC to their crucial role in wars as messengers. We uncover how their anatomy, diet, intelligence, and breeding habits have helped them thrive in urban spaces. From being Darwin’s example for natural selection to saving thousands of lives in World War II, pigeons have been deeply tied to human history. Yet today, they are seen as both companions and pests.

Modern cities mimic the rocky cliffs pigeons once called home. With endless nesting spots, abundant food sources, year-round breeding cycles, and few natural predators, pigeons have become the ultimate city survivors. Their incredible navigation skills and surprising intelligence — even passing the mirror test — give them an edge over most birds. This video takes you through the science, history, and quirks of why pigeons are everywhere, revealing why we created this urban bird boom in the first place.

If you’ve searched for why are there so many pigeons, pigeons in cities explained, history of carrier pigeons, Darwin pigeons natural selection, pigeon intelligence, why pigeons thrive, this video gives you the rational perspective.
